questions.q: Which longtime DC editor is credited, with Dennis O'Neil and Neal Adams, as a creator of Ra's al Ghul?
questions.why: Editor Julius Schwartz conceived the villain and his name, with O'Neil writing and Adams drawing.

questions.q: In which year did Ra's al Ghul debut in Batman #232?
questions.why: Ra's first appeared in Batman #232, dated June 1971.

questions.q: What name is given to the restorative chemical pools Ra's uses to extend his life?
questions.why: Lazarus Pits can heal injuries and revive the dying; repeated dips have given Ra's a lifespan of centuries.

questions.q: The name Ra's al Ghul is often translated into English as what title?
questions.why: The Arabic name is usually rendered 'Head of the Ghoul', which gives Ra's his comics title of the Demon's Head.

questions.q: Which of Ra's daughters is Batman's love interest in the comics?
questions.why: Talia, who debuted in 1971, is Batman's on-again, off-again love and the mother of his son.

questions.q: Which Robin is the grandson of Ra's al Ghul?
questions.why: Damian is the son of Talia al Ghul and Bruce Wayne, which makes Ra's his grandfather.

questions.q: Which of Ra's daughters, created in 2003 by Greg Rucka and Klaus Janson, is his oldest known child?
questions.why: Nyssa Raatko debuted in 2003 and is his eldest known daughter; she mortally wounds him in Death and the Maidens.

questions.q: Who played Ra's al Ghul across Christopher Nolan's Dark Knight trilogy?
questions.why: Liam Neeson played the role, first appearing in Batman Begins as the mentor Henri Ducard.

questions.q: Which actor played Ra's al Ghul in the Arrowverse series Arrow?
questions.why: Australian actor Matt Nable played Ra's in Arrow.

questions.q: Which actor played Ra's al Ghul in the TV series Gotham?
questions.why: Alexander Siddig portrayed Ra's in Gotham.
